description: Face quality canon with specific focus on facial features for photoreal and stylized outputs.

quality_dimensions.name: Eye Quality
quality_dimensions.description: Eyes must be natural, matched, and correctly placed.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Both eyes same size and shape. Gaze direction natural. Pupils round and aligned.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Mismatched eyes, cross-eyed, milky pupils, or impossible gaze.

quality_dimensions.name: Mouth and Teeth Quality
quality_dimensions.description: Mouth and teeth must be anatomically correct and natural.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Teeth count and spacing natural. Lip boundary clean. No gum overexposure.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Merged teeth, extra teeth, unnatural gum line, or lip boundary artifacts.

quality_dimensions.name: Skin Texture
quality_dimensions.description: Skin must have appropriate texture without plastic or wax appearance.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Pores, fine lines, and natural skin variation present. No over-smoothing.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Plastic, wax, or porcelain skin. Over-smoothed to loss of humanity.

quality_dimensions.name: Facial Symmetry
quality_dimensions.description: Face must have natural symmetry within human variance.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Minor asymmetry acceptable. No grossly unbalanced features.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Severe facial asymmetry indicating distortion or generation failure.
